capabilities: Log timestamped rows to monthly CSV files via tappable buttons
Create built-in and custom tracker templates from commands or settings
Edit tracker labels, buttons, columns, and defaults in settings or Markdown
Generate monthly summaries, rollups, and validation reports
Build an index note and a multi-tracker dashboard note
disambiguation: The dashboard is a Markdown note of tappable buttons, not a charting or analytics dashboard.
extras: README states the dashboard is not an analytics dashboard and the plugin includes no charts, sync, or Dataview/Bases integration; it lists known limitations such as no persistent current values. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to tap a button and log a timestamped event to a plain CSV file, so tracking repeated events like snacks or habits requires manual entry.
summary: One-tap tracker plugin whose tappable buttons in note code blocks log timestamped rows to monthly CSV files, with summaries, dashboards, and settings-based tracker editing.
